says: Ana founds a Team; Ben and Cho join by invitation, their own key binding, Ana's in-person verification of that key recorded on the Team, and consent, and Ana grants an 'editors' group read, use and contribute with Ben and Cho as its approved members. Cho, who holds no grant authority, revises the editors grant to add Dan, and the owner refuses it with group_membership_escalation. Ana then takes Ben out of the approved set: a revision keeps its grant's holder, so she revokes the editors grant by its next revision and issues the editors group a new grant whose approved set is Cho alone. Cho contributes on the new grant, but Ben's contribution offering the first revision of the editors grant, whose member list still names him, is refused with grant_not_held. Ana then configures a Google and a Slack connection, sets policy version 2 with an admission rule for the Google hosted domain, and grants a 'readers' group read and use delegated to the Google connection. Dan signs in through Slack; his verified Slack claim, offered with the readers grant to read the knowledge collection at its current head, is refused with grant_not_held because it is not a claim from the delegated connection. None of the refusals commits or moves a head.
